walk_this_line_marking.name: Walk This Line — Floor Marking
walk_this_line_marking.description: A legend painted on the floor reading WALK THIS LINE (the words are a parameter, legend_text), with a guide stripe - rebuilt PROCEDURALLY, no glb: a matte slab (a BoxMesh, thickness stripe_h_m, so the line reads from every angle and not only from above) and a stencil, white by default because a floor marking is white in the world. The line as INSTRUCTION: nothing about paint prevents anything, it works by being read and obeyed. Pairs with do_not_cross_barrier - perpendicular relations to one line: the tape forbids crossing it, this commands following it.

measurements.source: procedural: stripe slab (stripe_len_m x stripe_h_m x stripe_w_m) plus the stencil at standoff_m

dev_themes: the line as instrument of exclusion
walk_this_line_marking.qfep_connection: Point_Lines argues that measure is also violence. The pair stands in PERPENDICULAR relations to one line: the tape forbids crossing it, this commands following it. A body meeting both has been told the line is impassable in one direction and obligatory in the other.
walk_this_line_marking.note: REBUILT 2026-08-19 from the glb-mounted version. Stripe became a BoxMesh slab 2026-09-08 (was a one-sided PlaneMesh). Config: #legend_text #stripe_len_m #stripe_w_m #stripe_h_m #standoff_m #show_stripe #paint_color:<html colour> #wear:0..1.
